content.short: Fantasy football league on Solana where players stake FOOTBALL tokens to compete for prizes.
content.description: In CrazyFootball, players pick a squad each gameweek, stake Football Tokens and climb the rankings for a share of a prize pool worth more than 10 million FOOTBALL. It has over 50,000 active players and has hosted 100,000 games, with a World Cup mode and VIP tier. The game runs on Solana, with a mobile app and a version playable inside World App.
content.meta: Build a fantasy football squad, stake FOOTBALL tokens and compete for prizes in CrazyFootball, on Solana and in World App.
